newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: HPL in US$43 million Italian hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: HPL in US$43 million Italian hotel deal.

text.p: Hotel Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to acquire the Four Seasons Hotel in Milan for a total purchase consideration of US$43 million.

Hotel Properties Ltd (HPL) said in a statement that a unit of a wholly-owned subsidiary had entered a conditional agreement with HIC Horizon B.V. and Hotel Investment Corp to acquire from HIC Horizon the entire share capital of and shareholders' loans to Regent Milano SpA, for a consideration of US$43 million.
Regent Milano owns the Four Seasons Hotel Milano and certain adjoining apartment/commercial space. The hotel has 78 deluxe rooms and 20 suites.
HPL said the acquisition, when completed, would enable it to add to its existing property portfolio a luxury hotel built on freehold land at a prime location.
Completion of the acquisition is scheduled for October 30, HPL said.
The purchase is not expected to have any material effect on earnings in the financial year ending December 31, 1996.
